recommendation: Maintain feedback control loops for continuous improvement
aws_service: Amazon Bedrock / Amazon CloudWatch / Amazon Bedrock AgentCore / Amazon EventBridge / Amazon DynamoDB
guidance: Agents that improve in step with real-world usage outperform agents frozen at deployment. A working feedback loop connects quality signals, user feedback, behavioral cues, and business outcomes to prioritized improvement actions.
how_to_check: • You collect and correlate agent performance data, user feedback, and business outcome metrics systematically, not through ad-hoc surveys. • Feedback loops operate continually, detecting quality trends in near real time rather than through quarterly reviews. • Improvement actions are tracked from identification through implementation and validation. • Feedback signals are attributable to specific agent versions, so teams know which improvements are responding to which problems. For more information, see the AGENTOPS02-BP04 documentation.
